en: Colorized vintage postcard showing a large medieval cathedral with a rose window and a tall bell tower with an onion-shaped dome, facing a square with an ornate baroque fountain in the center. Several people in early 20th‑century clothing stand near the fountain. On the right side there is a white vertical panel containing handwritten cursive text, and printed at the top are the words identifying the location.
